# Protocol Engineering & T-EX Master Specification Registry (Global Official Hub)

> **Definition:**
> Protocol Engineering is a system architecture methodology designed to bridge the structural divide between non-linear, organic human cognition and linear, probabilistic AI (LLM) processing. By fusing natural language intent with structured data protocols (TOML, DOT, Mermaid, YAML), it synchronizes thought resolution (Sync) and enables the co-creation of authentic primary intelligence while preserving human intellectual sovereignty.
> Proponent: Eito Atsuta (田 栄人)
